self-limited.definition: a relating to a disease that tends to run a definite course without treatment

self-limiting.translation: a. 限制自己的, 制约本身的

self-loader.definition: n a firearm that reloads itself

self-loading.definition: s (of firearms) capable of automatic loading and firing continuously
self-loading.translation: a. 自行装填的, 自动的

self-loathing.translation: n. 自我讨厌的；自我憎恨的

self-love.definition: n. an exceptional interest in and admiration for yourself
self-love.translation: n. 自爱, 利己主义

self-loving.definition: s characteristic of those having an inflated idea of their own importance

self-lubricating.translation: 自动润滑的; 自润滑

self-luminous.definition: s having in itself the property of emitting light
